title: Northgate Tire Center Tariff — Charge for a Flat Repair
content:
# Tariff clause: the flat repair

The flat repair charge on a Northgate Tire Center package is the package's flat repair fee for the repaired tire, rounded to the cent, so a package whose flat repair fee is zero is charged nothing.

## Application

| Point | Basis |
|---|---|
| Repair charged | the most recent flat repair entry recorded on the package, one charge for the repaired wheel, dated on that repair's work order |
| Fee | the flat repair fee of the package held |
| Rounding | the charge is carried at full precision and rounded to the cent once, at the end; no intermediate amount is rounded on its own |

## Worked figures (hypothetical fees)

- A package with a hypothetical flat repair fee of $14.00: the repair is charged $14.00.
- A package whose flat repair fee is $0.00: the repair is charged nothing.
